definitions.explanation: The combining of two or more companies or organizations into one.

examples.japanese: 2つの{会社|かいしゃ}が{合併|がっぺい}した。
{合併|がっぺい}によって{規模|きぼ}が{大|おお}きくなった。
examples.english: The merger increased the company's scale.

examples.japanese: {市町村|しちょうそん}{合併|がっぺい}で{新|あたら}しい{市|し}ができた。
examples.english: A new city was formed through municipal merger.

notes:
{合併|がっぺい} refers to the merger or consolidation of organizations.

WORD STRUCTURE:
{合|がっ} (combine) + {併|ぺい} (merge) - to join together.

VERB FORM:
{合併|がっぺい}する: to merge
{合併|がっぺい}される: to be merged

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会社|かいしゃ}が{合併|がっぺい}する: companies merge
- {市町村|しちょうそん}{合併|がっぺい}: municipal merger
- {合併|がっぺい}{交渉|こうしょう}: merger negotiations
- {合併|がっぺい}{後|ご}: after the merger
- {合併|がっぺい}{比率|ひりつ}: merger ratio

CONTEXTS:
- Business: company mergers (M&A)
- Government: municipal consolidation ({平成|へいせい}の{大|だい}{合併|がっぺい})

RELATED:
- {買収|ばいしゅう}: acquisition
- {統合|とうごう}: integration
